name: android-appium-device-lock
description: Serialize Android UI and end-to-end test runs with a device-side adb file lock.

interface.shortDescription: Serialize Appium tests on one Android device.
interface.longDescription: Guides Codex to acquire a device-side file lock before Android Appium, UIAutomator, Espresso, or end-to-end test runs so only one app test controls a phone or emulator at a time.
defaultPrompt: Add a device lock around this Android Appium test command.
Serialize these Android E2E tests so one device only runs one suite at a time.
Use adb to wait for an existing Appium device lock before starting tests.
Show device lock ownership and lease expiry.
